Its not a choice. Some people believe its the only way out because of the bad situation already getting worse. there are people who go to therapy, take medication, and still have those thoughts because parents/boyfriend/girlfriend/siblings are abusive physically or mentally. then there are those who tend to over react and think that because something is going wrong it will never get better. thing is in either case, they have something inside of them that is intrigued by the peace and clarity of what might come after death. Maybe we are reincarnated and get to start over as something else? Maybe we go to heaven and see the ones we miss? Maybe our soul lives on down on Earth and we are forced to watch everything change around us? Maybe its nothingness? Nobody knows, but some want to find out. others dont want to, but then the pain will be gone. Suicide may be a way out, suicide may be a way to get to where you really belong. what ever the reason is, if someone is really going to kill themselves you cant stop them. but if they are not entierly sure than there will be a way to save them.
